pages.text: [#](53341a)The first hunger fades only after feeding, and the body starts to change.[#]() [#](53341a)Mesmerised victims can be held still, but draining too deeply has consequences.[#]() [#](53341a)Water no longer steals breath and poison finds no purchase.[#]()
pages.title: The Curse Takes Hold

pages.text: [#](53341a)Flame is less easily cheated: resistance may hide the burning, but not the curse's pain.[#]() [#](53341a)After mastery, the vampire begins to sense time, hunger, and sunlight differently.[#]()
[#](53341a)Sunlight can be collected and turned back on the curse until the burning dulls.[#]() [#](53341a)Blazes and fortress fire mark the next trial of endurance.[#]()
